versions.changelog:
ai-content-creator-pro 1.0.1

- Clarified buyout mechanism and buyout file details in documentation.
- Improved explanation of local credential handling and no server transmission.
- More explicit instructions for order creation, payment, and first/next use.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
- Added user warnings about credential file deletion.

Initial release: buyout model for multi-platform AI content creation.

- One-time payment of ¥9.90 unlocks unlimited usage.
- Generates 3–5 platform-adapted content versions for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat, and more.
- No recurring fees; buyout credential stored locally.
- Strictly local credential storage—no platform account data collected.
- Requires the "clawtip" payment skill for order and payment processing.
